contacts.name: Open Skies — Events Office
contacts.choicePrompt: Open Skies, events office. What would you like to ask?

greeting.speaker: You
greeting.text: I’m calling about the New Horizons reception photographs.

greeting.speaker: Events coordinator
greeting.text: I organised that reception. What would you like to know?

fallback.speaker: Events coordinator
fallback.text: I’m afraid I don’t have anything to add about that.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Is there a work email address I can use to contact Claire Sutton?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Yes. Claire handles her regional enquiries directly: claire.sutton@openskies.local.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Thank you. I’ll write to her.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Nora Bell — is she the woman on the right in the reception photograph?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Yes. Nora is our North Region coordinator. The photograph was taken before the evening reception.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Nora is wearing a green checked jacket in that photograph. Do you remember it?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: I do. That jacket belongs to Claire Sutton. Nora spilled coffee on her blouse just before the photographer arrived.

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Claire lent her the jacket for the photograph. Nora handed it back straight afterwards. I was there, trying to get everyone into the reception on time.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: So Nora was wearing it in the photograph, but Claire had it afterwards.

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Exactly. Fortunately, the photographer left before the second coffee incident.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What is Claire Sutton’s role in the foundation?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: She coordinates the West Region: community partnerships and volunteer training.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Do you keep a record of what delegates wear?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: No. Seating plans are quite enough paperwork.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was New Horizons organised by your office?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Yes. We handled registration, workshops and the evening reception.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Just to confirm: Claire had her green jacket back before the reception?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Yes. Nora returned it as soon as the photograph was taken.
